archetypes.name: routing-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The change spans many vendor-routing call sites and legacy compatibility flags.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether Step 0 probe health is used only for degraded-gate decisions. Check that downstream vendor dispatch decisions use binary-found state or fresh executable checks, and that stale CODEX_PRESENT or CURSOR_PRESENT values cannot suppress expected slots. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: env-contract
archetypes.rationale: Durable session env semantics changed across design and implement resumes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace session setup, write-env, write-design-env, and bootstrap resume paths. Verify probe-health globals are not persisted, immediate gate output still carries presence for Step 0, and resume paths refresh or avoid missing health values safely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-legacy
archetypes.rationale: Legacy shell dispatchers still accept deprecated availability flags.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect shell dispatch, voter, and launcher helpers for compatibility-only flag handling. Confirm missing binaries fast-fail without retry, executable non-zero exits remain retryable where intended, and manifest slot counts are not reduced by Step 0 health. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
